review:
The series goes steampunk, and the cap doubles to 100,000x. The bonus keeps the classic persistent symbols and adds new ones on top, so the round gets busy fast.

It's more complicated than Money Train 2, which is exactly why a practice run helps before you put money in. You'll want to know what each symbol does before it lands. Very high volatility, 96.1% RTP. No demo on this page.
